support-this knows the 12 platforms that GitHub's `FUNDING.yml` supports. This page lists one account on each, so you can see every platform's icon and link. The Tidelift and LFX Mentorship values are the examples from GitHub's documentation.

## Configuration

```yaml
extensions:
  support-this:
    description: "One link on every platform."
    platforms:
      github: coatless
      patreon: username
      ko_fi: username
      buy_me_a_coffee: username
      liberapay: username
      open_collective: username
      tidelift: npm/babel
      issuehunt: username
      community_bridge: cloud-foundry
      polar: username
      thanks_dev: u/gh/username
      custom: "https://paypal.me/username"
filters: [support-this]
```

The links are listed by platform name, with custom links last. The [home page](index.qmd#supported-platforms) lists each key and the value it expects.

## Icons

The GitHub, Patreon, Ko-fi, Buy Me a Coffee, Liberapay, Open Collective, and LFX Mentorship (Linux Foundation) logos come from [Simple Icons](https://simpleicons.org) (CC0). Simple Icons has no logo for Tidelift, IssueHunt, Polar, or thanks.dev, so those platforms, and custom links, use generic icons: a box, a target, a sparkle, a heart, and a link. Typst and Word output use the same icons.
